dual_franka.name: describe_dual_franka_setup
dual_franka.description: Read the dual-Franka runtime conventions, camera aliases, VLA policy conditioning text, semantic stop rules, and available primitive names before acting. This is read-only.

dual_franka.name: back_project

camera.description: Registered projection view name, e.g. d455 or base (default d455). Valid names come from perception.projection_views and the current state's saved artifacts.

dual_franka.name: segment
dual_franka.description: Use SAM3 on a registered RGB image with either a text prompt or one positive [row, col] point, return a mask overlay for verification, and estimate the mask median point in shared right-base coordinates.

camera.description: Registered projection view name, e.g. d455 or base (default d455). Valid names come from perception.projection_views and the current state's saved artifacts.

prompt.description: Text prompt for SAM3. Prefer short object/relation phrases; for the clean-desk box use 'white interior of the black cardboard box' or 'cardboard box'. Avoid over-specific surface words such as 'floor' when grounding is weak. Provide exactly one of prompt or point.

point.description: Positive SAM3 point in camera image coordinates [row, col]. Provide exactly one of prompt or point.

dual_franka.name: recover_joint_posture
dual_franka.description: Reset both arms to their healthy configured joint posture while preserving each gripper's open/closed state. Closed grippers are re-commanded before/after the joint reset so held objects stay clamped, then both TCPs return near their prior poses.

dual_franka.name: vla_right_grasp

prompt.description: Planner-facing segment intent. This is recorded in the tool result; the current live clean-desk checkpoint still receives its fixed training instruction during policy inference.

dual_franka.name: vla_handoff
dual_franka.description: Run the learned bimanual handoff VLA segment. The capability boundary is right-gripper release followed by the configured settle delay; do not rule-base pre-position either arm for it.

prompt.description: Planner-facing segment intent. This is recorded in the tool result; the current live clean-desk checkpoint still receives its fixed training instruction during policy inference.

dual_franka.name: vla_left_place

libero.name: rotate_pitch
libero.description: Tilt the gripper about world x (pitch 0 = pointing down, +pi/2 = pointing +y). Give target_pitch or delta_pitch, radians. Holds xyz and yaw. Use before entering a narrow opening facing ±y.

libero.name: move_pose
libero.description: Servo xyz and pitch/yaw together each step. Use when move_to stalls on deep or low reaches (cabinet fronts, microwave). gripper defaults to -1 (open): pass +1 while holding.

libero.name: back_project
libero.description: World xyz of a pixel (row, col; row 0 = top) in the current camera image, from the depth world map. Region mode: row_range + col_range (+ optional z_min/z_max) returns the midpoint of world xy over that window, e.g. a container's interior center. Pixels from the 1024 images use resolution high (default).

z_min.description: Region mode: keep pixels with world z >= z_min

z_max.description: Region mode: keep pixels with world z <= z_max

robocasa.name: finish
robocasa.description: Declare the task finished: when success (robocasa_terminated) becomes true, or when genuinely stuck after honest exploration. Give a 1-3 sentence summary of what worked and what failed. Success is the env's state.success, not this call.

robocasa.name: move_to
robocasa.description: Scripted EEF servo to a world-frame XYZ target via the OSC controller. Holds pitch/yaw orientation (use rotate_pitch to reorient). gripper='hold' (default) maintains current finger width: carry-safe without crushing small objects. Pass 'close' to close, 'open' to open. Never command a single move_to with |dxyz| > 0.30: OSC flips IK; split long traversal into 2-3 waypoints at carry z.

gripper.description: 'close', 'open', or 'hold' to maintain the current finger width (default 'hold')

robocasa.name: move_delta
robocasa.description: Relative EEF displacement: target = current_eef + dxyz, then move_to. Use for small adjustments (micro-align for grasp, approach). gripper='hold' (default) maintains current finger width.

robocasa.name: rotate_pitch
robocasa.description: Tilt the wrist forward (axis-angle about the control X-axis); pitches the gripper down/up. Holds xyz fixed. Use before threading the gripper into a narrow opening whose front face normal is along world +/-y.

n.description: Number of env steps for the rotation (default 12)

robocasa.name: set_gripper
robocasa.description: Hold the current EEF pose and drive the gripper command for `steps` env steps. Use to firm up a grip mid-carry or to actively open/close the gripper.

robocasa.name: release
robocasa.description: Open the gripper for `steps` env steps while holding the EEF in place (set_gripper(-1)). Use to drop a grasped object.

robocasa.name: scripted_grasp
robocasa.description: Coarse scripted grasp: open -> hover above target -> descend -> close -> lift. A fallback when the VLA closed-loop grasp is unavailable; for hard objects prefer rldx_arm. approach_z and grasp_z_offset are offsets from the target xyz.

approach_z.description: Z offset above target before descent, m (default 0.10)

grasp_z_offset.description: Z offset at grasp point (default 0.0; negative = below target)

step_clip.description: Per-step dxyz cap during approach, m (default 0.02)

robocasa.name: rldx_skill
robocasa.description: RLDX-1 VLA closed-loop skill with FULL base motion: the VLA drives both arm and mobile base. Use for full-body tasks where the base must reposition. Pass the complete live task_language verbatim; the runtime always uses that environment language. Do NOT interrupt consecutive VLA calls with manual primitives: that breaks VLA frame history continuity (sets vla_desync).

base_clip.description: Base motion cap, >= 0 (default: no clamp); a negative value means no clamp

force_reset.description: Force VLA frame history reset (default false)

settle_patience.description: Settle chunk budget before declaring done (default 999; do NOT set small)

robocasa.name: rldx_arm
robocasa.description: RLDX-1 VLA closed-loop skill with the base CLAMPED to small motions (base_clip 0.1): the VLA drives the arm for precise micro-alignment but cannot drive the base away. Pass the complete live task_language verbatim. Do NOT interrupt consecutive VLA calls with manual primitives.

base_clip.description: Base motion cap, >= 0 (default 0.1 = small); a negative value means no clamp

force_reset.description: Force VLA frame history reset (default false)

settle_patience.description: Settle chunk budget before declaring done (default 999; do NOT set small)

robocasa.name: navigate_to
robocasa.description: Drive the mobile base toward a WORLD (x, y) target. Online-calibrates the base forward heading, then turns to face and drives forward closed-loop. Holds the arm in place. gripper='hold' (default) maintains finger width while driving. Use tol = expected approach distance + object radius.

robocasa.name: move_base
robocasa.description: Raw base velocity commands in the robot's LOCAL frame: +forward drives forward, +lateral strafes right, +turn rotates CCW (yaw). Values clamped to [-1, 1]. Use for fine base adjustments near a target; navigate_to for long range. gripper='hold' (default) maintains finger width while driving.

robocasa.name: view_env_state
robocasa.description: Read state NN (default latest): env state, success (robocasa_terminated), task_progress, vla_desync, the command log, and the agentview (calibration frame), navview (base floor view) and wrist images. Use agentview pixels for back-projection, navview for base navigation and floor walkability, wrist for close-range details near the gripper.

robocasa.name: back_project_batch
robocasa.description: Back-project MULTIPLE pixels [row, col] (row 0 = image top) to world XYZ from one state's world map. Returns each pixel's world_xyz plus summary.median_xyz. For robust localization sample 3-8 pixels on the target and read summary.median_xyz. Max 50 pixels. Pixels from agentview_high need resolution 'high'.

resolution.description: low = the 256x256 world map (default); high = the --hi-res agentview map

robocasa.name: query_world_map
robocasa.description: Query the latest world map by Z band / XY region to find objects at specific heights: keeps pixels with z_min <= z <= z_max (optionally within x_range / y_range) and clusters them on an image grid. Typical: z 0.85-0.95 = countertop objects; z 0.0-0.12 with camera 'navview' = walkable floor.

resolution.description: low = the 256x256 world map (default); high = the --hi-res agentview map

robolab.name: act
robolab.description: Execute one action unit (MV_FWD, MV_BACK, MV_LEFT, MV_RIGHT, MV_UP, MV_DOWN, STOP, GRASP, RELEASE, DONE), repeated n times. MV_* move the gripper ~2 cm; GRASP closes, RELEASE opens, STOP holds one step, DONE means the task is complete (call finish). Returns the new images and state.

target_in_wrist.description: WRIST CHECK: is the TARGET visible in the wrist view?

plan.description: Only with target_in_wrist false: up to 3 MV_* moves run in order (replaces unit and n)

robolab.name: plan
robolab.description: Subgoal plan: `stages` replaces the plan from the current stage on (ordered GRASP/LIFT/MOVE/PLACE/RELEASE/RETREAT/REASON stages, each with a visible DONE WHEN); `done: true` marks the current stage complete. The current stage is shown in every act result.

motion.description: GRASP, LIFT, MOVE, PLACE, RELEASE, RETREAT or REASON

affordance.description: The one visible part to aim at

description.description: Visual strategy; for REASON the complete IF ... THEN rule

completion.description: DONE WHEN: a condition visible in the images

arm.description: Dual-arm robots: the arm of this stage

done.description: The current stage's DONE WHEN is visible

robolab.name: reset
robolab.description: Exploration only. Abandon the current episode and restore the same initial scene. Archive the failed attempt first and state which strategy lever changes in the next attempt.

reason.description: Why this episode is unrecoverable and what will change

robolab.name: finish
robolab.description: End the episode after checking the latest state. Success is RoboLab's task predicate, not this call.

robolab.name: view_env_state
robolab.description: Current state with the front (third-person) and wrist images.

robolab.name: move_delta
robolab.description: Translate the gripper by a base-frame [dx, dy, dz] in metres (+x away from the base, +y toward the robot's left, +z up; at most 0.3 m per call), optionally opening or closing the gripper first. The orientation is locked. Returns the new state and images.

robotwin.name: reset
robotwin.description: Exploration only. Abandon the current episode and restore the same initial scene. Archive the failed attempt first and state which strategy lever changes in the next attempt.

reason.description: Why this episode is unrecoverable and what will change

robotwin.name: finish
robotwin.description: Stop the run after a fresh status check. RoboTwin's eval_success is authoritative; requesting success cannot override it.

robotwin.name: view_env_state
robotwin.description: Read one recorded state (step -1 = latest, 0 = initial): command, result, native episode status, robot state, and the head, left wrist and right wrist RGB images.

robotwin.name: render
robotwin.description: Capture a fresh synchronized observation as a new state without moving.

robotwin.name: sample_world_xyz
robotwin.description: Median world xyz (m) around [row, col] pixels of a recorded state's view, from same-step metric depth. Read-only.

view.description: View whose RGB supplied the pixels; also the pixel coordinate space

robotwin.name: query_world_map
robotwin.description: World-xyz samples and min/max/median stats over a half-open [row_start, col_start, row_end, col_end] box of a recorded state's view. Read-only.

view.description: View whose RGB supplied the pixels; also the pixel coordinate space

robotwin.name: lingbot_act
robotwin.description: Run LingBot-VLA eef16 action chunks (50 native actions each) on the native task instruction. The optional prompt is recorded but never sent to the policy.

robotwin.name: move_to
robotwin.description: Plan (curobo) and move one arm's EEF to a world-frame xyz and wxyz orientation (default: keep current). The planned qpos waypoints are executed from fresh state. EEF is not TCP: do not send a raw object surface point.

gripper.description: Gripper command held along the path, 0 closed .. 1 open; omit to keep it

substeps.description: Planner waypoints executed, evenly subsampled (default 25; 0 = all)

robotwin.name: rotate_wrist
robotwin.description: Rotate one EEF about world z by a relative angle in degrees (EEF xyz fixed; the TCP and a held object sweep an arc).

gripper.description: Gripper command held along the path, 0 closed .. 1 open; omit to keep it

substeps.description: Planner waypoints executed, evenly subsampled (default 25; 0 = all)

robotwin.name: set_gripper
robotwin.description: Linearly move one normalized gripper (0 closed, 1 open) to val over `steps` native actions (default 10).

robotwin.name: release
robotwin.description: Open one gripper to val (default 1.0) over `steps` native actions (default 10).
